brief introduction == History ==
Quotation from AntiQuads home page:
"Yeah, a little about our history... The clan Antiquad was born in
November 1998. The founders of the clan were NiceAss and Thunder.
Fist the name was 'SS', but then we learned that there had been
a clan called Super Sonics... So, we had to change the name.
None of us was using quad, never...
Then revel figured out the name, and big thanks to him, the Clan Antiquad was born!
After our true newbie days were over we found ourselves playing with powerups enabled."
